From our kitchen
  to your special moments

↻Drag to turn the handi, tap it to release the spices

  1. Step one

    The pan meets the flame

    A seasoned iron kadai over an open burner, oil shimmering as it heats.

  2. Step two

    Temper the aromatics

    Onions, green chillies, curry leaves and tomato hit the oil, then the chicken goes in.

  3. Step three

    Bloom the spices

    Turmeric, chilli and garam masala, poured by hand until the kitchen smells right.

  4. Step four

    Toss over open fire

    A flash of flame, one confident toss, and everything comes together.

  5. Step five

    Sealed in the handi

    Layered with rice and sealed in brass, the way biryani should be served.

Live cooking,
right at your event.

Our chefs set up hot stations at your venue, so food goes from flame to plate in seconds. The sizzle, the aroma and the show become part of the celebration.

  • Kotthu & wok stationSweet fried chicken, mutton or seafood kotthu, fried rice and devilled dishes.
  • Dosa & appam stationCrisp dosa, soft appam, idly and idiyappam, made to order.
  • Grill stationChicken tikka, kebab and beef steak, straight off the charcoal.

    A few helpful details

    Before we
    set the table.

    Still wondering about something? Message us on WhatsApp or call +1 (365) 994-6989.

    Can we combine different cuisines?

    Yes. Use Build your menu to combine Sri Lankan, Indian and Arab dishes in one order. The final menu and availability are agreed with you before booking.

    How much does catering cost?

    Your quote depends on the date, guest count, menu, venue and service requirements. Tell us what you have in mind, including an optional budget, so the proposal can reflect your event.

    Can you accommodate dietary requirements?

    Tell us about vegetarian, vegan, halal or allergy requirements when you reach out. Ingredients, preparation methods and any cross-contact concerns must be confirmed before you book. Dietary labels here describe sample dishes, not a safety guarantee.

    Which areas do you serve?

    We cater across the Greater Toronto Area. Share your venue or city so we can confirm availability, delivery and any travel charges.

    Does an enquiry confirm my booking?

    No. Your date, menu, pricing and service arrangements need to be confirmed before a booking is agreed. A WhatsApp order or quote request starts that conversation.
